opportunities.name: AA flight status lookup by flight number and date
opportunities.description: On aa.com Flight status, look up a flight by entering a flight number and choosing a travel date, then run the search.
steps: Click the 'Flight status' tab on the aa.com home booking widget.
Click the 'Flight number' chip under 'Search by'.
Click the Flight number input and type the flight number.
Open the Date dropdown and select the desired date.

instances.values: flight_number=6944, date=Thursday, April 6 (date changed at 1037.3s, Search at 1039.5s)

opportunities.name: Amtrak deals filtered by region
opportunities.description: On Amtrak.com, open Deals & Promotions and filter the deal list by a US region from the 'Display deals in' dropdown.
steps: Click the 'DEALS' item in the Amtrak top navigation.
Click the 'Display deals in' region dropdown (default 'All Regions').
Choose the region option from the list (e.g. National, Northeast, Northwest, West, Midwest, South, California).

opportunities.name: FlightAware product tier comparison
opportunities.description: On FlightAware.com, open a product from the Products menu and jump to its tier or plan comparison page.
steps: Click 'Products' in the FlightAware top navigation.
Click the product or subscription entry to open (e.g. AeroAPI, Premium Subscriptions).
Click the 'Compare Tiers Now' or 'Compare Subscriptions' button.
Optionally click 'Upgrade' on a chosen tier.
